text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT OPEN — latency spike impacting streaming and page-backed requests. p99 across inference fleet >3s, p95 elevated. Auto-alert triggered at 03:12 UTC. Please ACK and join #incidents-bridge if you are oncall.

sara: Acked. I’m oncall. Seeing large p99 jump starting 03:10 UTC after the midnight rollout. p95 ~900ms (baseline 250-350ms), p99 ~3.8s (baseline ~1.1s). Streaming stalls and some clients report stalled partial responses.

ali: I'm seeing lots of cache miss events in the prefix cache telemetry. Miss rate jumped from ~8% -> 68% around 03:09. Eviction pressure increased and paging started on several nodes.

jen_ops: On the infra side, a config change for prefix rekeying went out in the v5 rollout at 02:58. Can someone confirm if the new prefix salt mapping matches the production shard mapping?

priya: Confirmed — the prefix-salt mapping in the rollout looks like it used an older manifest by mistake (manifest-202402). New mapping is manifest-202403. So keys are landing in wrong buckets. That would cause high prefix miss rates.

mateo: That lines up with logs: repeated entries like `prefix_lookup: miss, expected_bucket=shard-13 actual_bucket=shard-7` across many inference workers. Example from worker-54: ``
[03:11:02.345] prefix_lookup miss key=abcd1234 expected=shard-21 actual=shard-5
[03:11:02.346] fallback fetch -> page -> latency 1750ms
``

ali: Paging metrics: page fetch count spiked x6, average page fetch latency increased to ~1.6s, which exacerbates tail token latency. Streaming stalls correlate with page fetch spikes (we see stalled decode loops waiting on page I/O).

sara: Customer impact: several PLG customers report slow responses and partial streaming timeouts (~2-5% of active sessions experiencing stalls). No large-scale request failures, but SLOs are likely breached at p99.

incident-bot: Severity: P2. Runbook: prefix-cache-mismatch -> rollback prefix-rekey, enable read-through fallback, and add emergency cache-ttl bump.

jen_ops: Plan: 1) Rollback prefix rekey rollout to previous manifest (manifest-202402) across the affected region (us-east-1) 2) Temporarily increase cache TTL to reduce miss amplification 3) Add routing rule to favor in-memory warm shards and avoid draining nodes that still have old key layout.

priya: I can push rollback. Will open deployment job: `deploy rollback --service=prefix-keys --to=manifest-202402 --region=us-east-1`

ali: While rollback runs, enable emergency fallback in runtime to attempt KV fetch from both mappings (dual-probe) — codeflag `runtime.dual_prefix_probe=true`. This will succeed for a lot of keys and should reduce miss rate quickly. I’ll flip the flag in feature-flag service. Command: ``
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"runtime.dual_prefix_probe","env":"prod","value":true}'
``

mateo: Observability: running a quick check: `sum(rate(prefix_cache_misses[1m]))` increased from 0.45/s -> 3.2/s on the fleet. After enabling dual probe I expect misses to drop. I’ll watch p95/p99 and streaming stall counters.

sara: I'll notify CS and impacted customers we have a mitigation plan (rollback + dual probe) and expect improvement in 10-15m. Priya — how long for rollback to hit all nodes?

priya: Rolling back in us-east-1 via canary 2 -> 10 -> 50 -> 100. ETA to full region ~12 minutes. Starting canary now.

incident-bot: DEPLOYMENT STARTED: rollback manifest-202402 by priya at 03:18 UTC.

ali: Flag flipped to true at 03:19 UTC. Initial metric check: prefix miss rate dropped to 1.2/s within 90s. Page fetch rate trending down.

mateo: p95 improving: from 900ms -> 420ms within 3 minutes of dual-probe. p99 down from 3.8s -> 1.6s. Streaming stall alerts decreasing (alerts per minute from 14 -> 4).

jen_ops: Rollback canary succeeded. Proceeding to 50%. No errors so far.

priya: Rollback completed to 100% in us-east-1 at 03:29 UTC. Manifest now set to manifest-202402.

incident-bot: DEPLOYMENT COMPLETE: rollback finished at 03:29 UTC.

sara: Great work. Observability baseline after rollback: prefix miss rate ~7%, p95 ~320ms, p99 ~980ms, streaming stalls near baseline. Still watching to ensure no regression in other regions.

customer-success-bot: Notifying customers who reported issues: message queued: "We've mitigated a transient latency issue caused by a recent prefix rekey rollout. Responses improving; we'll share a post-incident summary shortly."

ali: Follow-ups: 1) Patch rollout validation steps were missing a manifest checksum verification — I’ll open PR to add a strict manifest hash check and a gating test. 2) Add a preflight in the rollout job: sample 1% of keys and confirm hit ratio >90% before wideroll. 3) Add observability alert for sudden miss-rate delta >5x within 5m.

priya: Ops follow-ups: add automatic rollback trigger if page fetch rate increases >3x within rollout window. Also add a flag to disable rekeying during peak hours.

mateo: Will prepare dashboard snapshot and timeline for postmortem. I’ll include metrics: prefix_miss_rate, page_fetch_rate, p95/p99, streaming_stall_count.

sara: Oncall Handoff: I’m staying on for 30 more minutes, will handoff to ali at 04:00 UTC if stable. If anyone sees p99 creep back up, ping me immediately.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) — mitigation: rollback + dual-probe flag. Status: degraded -> stable at 03:34 UTC. Postmortem scheduled in 24h.

sara: Closing notes for handoff: root cause = prefix rekey rollout used wrong manifest resulting in wrong shard mapping -> massive cache miss + page surge -> tail latency. Customer impact: partial streaming stalls for ~2-5% sessions, SLO at p99 briefly breached. Next steps captured above.

ali: A few quick commands we ran (for triage):
```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference -o wide
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?query=sum(rate(prefix_cache_misses[1m]))"
deploy rollback --service=prefix-keys --to=manifest-202402 --region=us-east-1
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"runtime.dual_prefix_probe","env":"prod","value":true}'
```

priya: Handing off to ali for watch. I’ll follow up on the rollout job PR and the automatic rollback rule.

ali: Taking watch. Thanks all.

customer-success-bot: Customer notifications sent at 03:40 UTC.

sara: Handoff complete 04:00 UTC — ali now oncall.

jen_ops: Adding incident tags: root_cause:manifest-mismatch, mitigation:rollback+dual-probe, severity:P2, region:us-east-1.

incident-bot: Postmortem checklist created: /incidents/postmortems/4460007777-prefix-rekey-mismatch
